answer: STD44857 provides testing, education and treatment of sexually transmitted diseases; medications for uninsured patients are provided by the STI program at ODH per an agreement between HCPH and ODH; All other medications are sent to patients' choice of pharmacy (not associated with HCPH);  Thus, for this particular program, there are no 340B purchases by STD44857

amount: For STD44857, there is no 340B income.  Expenditures include staff time to conduct inventory, reporting to ODH on a quarterly basis, ordering medications from ODH, administration and documentation of administration of 340B medications.
